content.short: Bridge portal for moving assets between Ethereum and the OP Stack chains of the Superchain.
content.description: Brid.gg started as a front end for the official bridges of OP Stack chains, letting users send assets from Ethereum to networks such as Unichain and World Chain without hunting for each chain's own portal. Transfers are now routed through LI.FI, so users can pick any supported source and destination chain and token from one screen.
content.meta: Move assets between Ethereum and Superchain networks like Unichain and World Chain from one bridge screen, routed by LI.FI.
